what_changes: in a table with an Amount header, a two-money Amount cell ('ID:6631798 INDN:NORTHSTAR VENDORS SE CO -74.88') has its LEADING text+number moved into the Description column and only the TRAILING money value promoted to the Amount cell
what_does_not_change: the clean second row (money-only Amount cell) is untouched
semantics_note: no token is deleted (F-11 is token-preserving, unlike F-1), but WHICH figure is treated as the row's transaction amount changes. Here the reference number 6631798 happens to be the value that gets relocated into free text, and -74.88 is correctly promoted -- but the function decides purely from cell shape (a trailing money-shaped value), never from which number the page actually printed as the amount. If the page's TRUE amount were the leading figure and the trailing figure merely a coincidentally money-shaped reference number, this function would promote the wrong one; this fixture demonstrates the mechanism, not that this specific example promotes the wrong figure
